title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive — Episode9 Someday With My Song

meta.Event Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, welcome back.
How'd your event go today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... It was fun, but it could've gone better.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You seem to be struggling a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time I sing, I feel like I'm missing something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like I'm not going all out, you know...?
I'm not singing with everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Is she still on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's only natural for you to think about her.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: After all, she was the partner you'd been looking for for so long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know I have to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know that I have to move on from Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think I'm never going to find a partner who's as good as her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means... I have to keep singing by myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to surpass RAD WEEKEND on my own...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You still have your whole life ahead of you. It's too soon for you to be giving up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I want to believe that, but—
<...hear me?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you hear a voice just now, Dad?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
...?
No, I didn't hear anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Why do I feel so anxious all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like I've forgotten something really important...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, where was I?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: When I say you're too young to be giving up, I'm not just talking about finding a new partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Kohane's feelings are her own.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which means you can't force her to perform with you again. Even if you could, it wouldn't be right.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As long as she hasn't started to hate singing, there's still a chance of her coming back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's what I was referring to when I said it's too soon to give up.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But given that... There's no telling what's going to happen even if you wait for her to return.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That may end up being more painful than giving up on her for good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've been running circles in my head thinking about how I forced Kohane to help make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that day... When I heard her sing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got the feeling that singing also meant a lot to her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I think she hasn't started hating it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I guess there still is a chance of her coming back, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's a “no comment” from me.
I mean, you know your partner the best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Dad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel like I know what I need to do now.
The next day

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm heading out now, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, stay safe out there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll be fine! I mean, I'm just going to my usual spot!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She still isn't fully back on her feet, but she seems resolved at least.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know this is a long shot.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (By clinging to this, I might end up feeling really disappointed.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I might wait and wait...and come out of this completely empty-handed.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've made the decision to keep singing here.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (In the hopes that I'll get Kohane's attention again!)

rows.Speaker: Movie
